q: Quantum error correction and topological quantum codes: the toric code (Kitaev, 1997) is a [[2n², n², d]] code on an n×n torus with:
opts: d = n (distance equal to system size)
d = n (the minimum weight logical operator has weight n — going around the torus)
exp: Toric code: encodes 2 logical qubits, has distance d = n (on n×n lattice). Logical operators are non-contractible loops on the torus, which have minimum weight n. Physical error rate below threshold (≈ 1%) allows scalable fault tolerance with growing distance d = n.
